cards.text: Река — поздняя литературная ветка, не проверенная последняя координата
Неизвестен переход от враждебной к защитной custody
Искать полости/вложенные объекты рентгеном/CT, не вскрытием
Mendes 1902: CG 53465–53469, especially an object catalogued as amulet/substitute/fragment rather than 'phallus'

marker_handling.result: The current Aura heuristic produced no independently testable semantic mapping for either marker; they remain logged inputs rather than evidence.

interpretive_synthesis.identity_reading: The strongest next test is not whether a descendant resembles the restored father-state, but where provenance became non-unique: the custody/substitution handoff is the candidate Veta boundary.
interpretive_synthesis.next_test: Resolve Mendes CG 53465–53469 object-by-object and inspect documented cavities/nested contents non-destructively where conservation permits; compare the resulting provenance graph against the surrogate model without changing node meanings after the fact.
interpretive_synthesis.disconfirming_condition: If complete object-card concordance and conservation/imaging records account for the assemblage with no unresolved substitute/fragment/container branch, demote the Mendes/Veta placement and move to the next preregistered control branch.

direct_answer: AURA points to the provenance/custody handoff as the useful Veta boundary. Do not strengthen 60 or 16:16 symbolically yet. First resolve the Mendes 1902 CG 53465–53469 chain and test the substitute-versus-original branch with non-destructive records/imaging.
